If at least one failed to reach the targeted accuracy, the VB application calculated new factor (eq 3) and offset values (eq 4) (based on the tested factor [a1] and offset [b1] values, the slope [a2] and intercept [b2] of the linear trend line equation obtained with the theoretical volumes and the calculated average vol- umes). The VB application exported the new factor and off- set values into a temporary TECAN EVOware liquid class file and started a new run for the same three volumes to fine-tune the calibration of the target volume (Fig. 3).
